name: Amy L. Drushal
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Tampa, Florida
about: Amy L. Drushal is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Tampa, Florida area. Providing legal representation in Florida for a variety of different issues, Amy Drushal was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Amy L. Drushal attended law school. Amy Drushal was enrolled at Stetson University College of Law. She earned a juris doctor degree in 2001. Amy Drushal was admitted to the practice of law in 2002.

Attorneys like Amy L. Drushal are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Amy Drushal represents clients with Business Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Banking, Employment Litigation: Defense, Bankruptcy: Business and Consumer Law.
